bio: Dr. Soumik Sarkar received his Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering from Penn State in 2011. He is currently a Professor of Mechanical Engineering and Computer Science and the Director of the Translational AI Center (TrAC) at Iowa State University. He also serves as the Associate Director of the USDA-NIFA-sponsored AI Institute for Resilient Agriculture (AIIRA). Dr. Sarkar's research interests include machine learning and decision and control, with applications to cyber-physical systems such as energy, transportation, design and manufacturing, and agricultural systems. He has co-authored more than 250 peer-reviewed publications and has received about $55M in research funding during his tenure at Iowa State. He won the ASME DSCD Rudolf Kalman Best Paper Award in 2021. Dr. Sarkar is a recipient of the NSF CISE Career Initiation Initiative (CRII) award in 2015, the Young Investigator award from the US Air Force Office of Scientific Research (AFOSR) in 2017, and the NSF CAREER award in 2019.
Dr. Soumik Sarkar.researchInterests: Machine learning, decision and control, cyber-physical systems

His work included the 2022 paper "Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Control with Multi-Fidelity Models" with Soumik Sarkar.
